definition:
ဧန

(pronoun.) takes this form in some cases.It has the meaning of "this", "it", referring to something that has been already mentioned.

ဧန္တ

(pr,p, of eti.) coming.

ena (pron.) [fr. pron. base *ç̆, cp. e--ka; to this cp. in form & meaning Lat. ūnus, Gr. oi)no/s, Ohg. ein, Oir. ōin] only used in acc. enaṃ (taṃ enaṃ) "him, this one, the same" Sn 583, 981, 1114; Dh 118, 313; J III.395; Nd2 304III.B. See also naṃ.
